# Cncf Cocktail Cloud Reviewer

Review Cocktail Cloud using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Distribution category. Cocktail Cloud is a container application management platform that provides a continuous development/deployment/operating environment for container-based applications.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
